data.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Shipped 85+ production changes over 18 months across three products — the Coop+ subscription app, the legacy enterprise learning platform, and a next-generation rebuild — using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Django, and .NET.
Led the Coop+ UI overhaul: brand colors, typography, spacing, responsive layouts, and redesigns of the course landing page and carousel navigation.
Built 23+ components for a growing design system from Figma with token-driven styling, variants, and accessibility, adopted across the next-gen platform.
Delivered systems and features like Library, Content Manager, and Courses for the next-gen rebuild: publishing, drafts, archiving, side navigation, and course CRUD with filter and sort.
Owned Stripe billing: hosted checkout, Billing Portal, webhook reliability, seat tiers, and QuickBooks-ready invoicing integration.
Primary responder for production incidents spanning authentication, payments, data integrity, analytics tracking, and app-store compliance.

data.title: Website and Media Development Coordinator
data.org: Associated Students of Oregon State University
bullets: As the Media and Website Development Coordinator for the Associated Students of Oregon State University (ASOSU), I played a pivotal role in supporting the executive branch by fostering and strengthening relationships with the student body and the broader community.
Collaborated with the executive branch to develop and maintain the ASOSU website, ensuring it was visually appealing and user-friendly.
Managed the ASOSU social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter) to enhance engagement and promote events.
